evidence.reason: At the pinned tip the guard at sdk.ts:743 still requires observation.error to be undefined before deriving the result-frame cause. When the SDK yields an error result and then the dispatch throws, the catch sets observation.error/errorKind=dispatch-threw, so lines 744-759 are skipped and the provider result cause is lost, allowing classification as a harness failure. This is an implementation error in existing error handling, not a new requirement.
